description: Exact-source isolated logical forward-upgrade rehearsal from PostgreSQL 16 to a fresh PostgreSQL 17 database. Current expand-only migrations are applied to both versions, synthetic source state is dumped with PostgreSQL 17 client tools and restored data-only into the fresh PostgreSQL 17 schema. This is not in-place pg_upgrade, physical replication, downgrade or production evidence.
requiredPhases: start isolated PostgreSQL 16 and PostgreSQL 17 containers on a private Docker network
apply the exact current canonical expand-only migration sequence independently to source and target
create synthetic active authority and deleted authority state only in PostgreSQL 16
use PostgreSQL 17 pg_dump to create a data-only custom-format dump from PostgreSQL 16
restore data into the fresh migrated PostgreSQL 17 target without schema contraction
compare bounded memory_os schema authority fingerprints across major versions
verify runtime roles remain NOBYPASSRLS and all protected tables remain FORCE RLS
verify active session authority resolves and deleted account/session authority does not resurrect
execute the complete canonical SQL integration suite on PostgreSQL 17
write exact source SHA and bounded counts without database URLs, credentials or synthetic identifiers
abortCriteria: source or target PostgreSQL major differs from the contract
containers are not isolated or database identity is ambiguous
current migration sequence cannot apply independently to either major
PostgreSQL 17 client cannot dump PostgreSQL 16 source
data restore requires destructive schema change or skips an error
runtime role, FORCE RLS, session authority or deletion non-resurrection verification fails
any canonical SQL integration test fails on PostgreSQL 17
evidence would contain credentials, database URLs or synthetic identifiers
limitations: ephemeral single-node PostgreSQL 16 and PostgreSQL 17 Docker containers
logical data-only dump and restore rather than in-place pg_upgrade
no extensions, replication slots, WAL, failover or connection-pool migration
synthetic authority and deletion state only
no production traffic, credentials or operator promotion
no downgrade or destructive contract migration
